question: What traits do Elves get in D&D 5.5e?
shortAnswer: A 2024 Elf is a Medium Humanoid with 30-foot speed, 60-foot Darkvision, Fey Ancestry against Charmed, a chosen Insight, Perception or Survival proficiency, Trance and a required Elven Lineage with benefits at character levels 1, 3 and 5.
introduction: Each shared Elf species trait serves a distinct purpose. Ability adjustments, languages and background feats come from the wider revised character-creation process, so it is important to separate them from the new Elf's own abilities.

blocks.text: The Elf's creature type is Humanoid. The revised Elf size is Medium; unlike some other revised species, this particular entry does not provide a choice between Small and Medium. The shared walking speed is 30 feet before applying any feature that explicitly changes it.

Creature type can matter when an effect targets a Humanoid. Size matters where general rules refer to a creature's space, movement or relative size, while the walking speed determines normal movement availability. Neither type nor size grants a universal stealth bonus or special movement mode.

Darkvision extends 60 feet. It treats dim light as bright light and darkness as dim light for the purpose of seeing. This can help an Elf navigate an unlit space or notice nearby silhouettes, but it is not a light source and does not reveal colors in darkness.

Within darkness viewed through Darkvision, reduced visual detail can still affect sight-based Perception checks. A magical effect that explicitly blocks Darkvision is not overcome simply because the character is an Elf. A specific lineage might change Darkvision's range, but no such child modification belongs to the shared 60-foot parent value.

sections.title: Fey Ancestry targets the Charmed condition

blocks.text: Fey Ancestry gives Advantage on saving throws the Elf makes to avoid or end Charmed. An Elf resisting a spell that calls for a saving throw to avoid that condition rolls with Advantage; if an applicable effect later offers a saving throw to end Charmed, the feature can help there too.

It does not provide general immunity to Charmed, all mind-influencing effects or other conditions. In the revised species, magical sleep prevention is part of Trance. It should not be inserted again into Fey Ancestry by copying the wording of the older 2014 trait.

sections.title: Choose one of three Keen Senses proficiencies

blocks.text: Keen Senses allows exactly one chosen skill proficiency from Insight, Perception or Survival. Insight can help with interpreting motives and behavior; Perception helps notice observable details; Survival can support tracking and other appropriate outdoors tasks. The choice is not a package of all three skills.

A character may already have one of these proficiencies from their class or background. Check those sources first and choose a different option if it creates more useful coverage. A second grant of the same proficiency does not automatically double proficiency or provide Expertise.

Trance means the Elf does not need to sleep and cannot be put to sleep by magic. The Elf can complete a Long Rest after four hours in trancelike meditation and retains consciousness during those hours. This is a species-specific rest procedure, not unlimited wakefulness without any rest.

An Elf who finishes a four-hour Long Rest receives the normal benefits of a completed Long Rest under the relevant rules. Other party members may still need their own rest periods. Trance does not provide immunity to damage, incapacitation or loss of consciousness from an effect that is not magical sleep.

sections.title: Elven Lineage adds a required magical choice

blocks.text: Choose Drow, High Elf or Wood Elf as the Elf's lineage. The chosen lineage gives an initial level-1 benefit, a spell at character level 3 and another spell at character level 5. The higher-level spells remain prepared, and each may be cast once without a spell slot per completed Long Rest, or with suitable spell slots if available.

Select Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for the spells cast using this lineage at the time of selection. This is a choice in the shared parent rule even though the exact benefit and spell names belong to the individual lineage. In D&D Portal, all three child content entries are pending and must not be treated as implemented.

blocks.caption: What the revised Elf grants
rows: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed
One of Insight, Perception or Survival
No sleep; magical sleep prevented; four-hour conscious Long Rest
One required lineage, level-1 gift and spell milestones at 3 and 5
Ability-score adjustments and normally an Origin feat
Common plus two standard language choices

blocks.text: Do not add the 2014 Elf's fixed Dexterity +2, automatic Perception proficiency or automatic Common and Elvish as extra species benefits. The updated baseline is complete as shared rules, but the choice of a specific lineage must still be made using its own official entry.

No lineage-specific additional movement, vision, spell name or level-one gift is published in this parent-only dataset. Those values will be introduced only with their verified separate child content.
